question: Should the idea be narrowed to a single well-controlled supervision experiment before adding the repair loop and RL stages?
description: The idea bundles three components (context-enriched supervision, adaptive one-hop repair loop, low-hop RL with deep-hop transfer). Given the challenge to H1 and the lack of support for H2, the direction may need to be narrowed to the single best-controlled question: does context-enriched supervision change multi-hop accuracy under matched budget and format, evaluated at the same inference context? The repair loop and RL stage may be premature scope.
rationale: Each added component multiplies compute and confounds attribution; the critique found the core premise weak and the transfer claim unsupported, so running the full pipeline first would risk an uninterpretable result.
